symbols.name: ActiveEntityAnnotationsValidationBehavior
symbols.summary: A behavior that validates entities before insert, update, or delete operations using DataAnnotations attributes.
symbols.remarks: Initializes a new instance of the BridgingIT.DevKit.Domain.ActiveEntityAnnotationsValidationBehavior%602 class. This behavior generates a FluentValidation validator from DataAnnotations attributes and caches it statically. Supported attributes include [Required], [StringLength], [MaxLength], [MinLength], [Range], [RegularExpression], [EmailAddress], [Phone], [Url], and [Compare].

syntax.content: public class ActiveEntityAnnotationsValidationBehavior : ActiveEntityBehaviorBase, IActiveEntityBehavior where TEntity : class, IEntity
